content.text: No exclusivity obligation binding Corio appears anywhere in the agreement; all license grants run to Corio on a nonexclusive basis, and Exhibit D cooperation terms are expressly non-binding.

input.quote: Commerce One hereby grants to Corio a fee-bearing, perpetual and irrevocable, nonexclusive, nontransferable (except in accordance with Section 14.1 of this Agreement), right and license in the Territory
input.rationale: The agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier, requirements or preferred-provider obligation on Corio (our party). Every grant of rights (Sections 2.1-2.4, 2.5, 12.3) is expressly "nonexclusive" and runs in Corio's favour, Section 2.7's restrictions are ordinary scope-of-use limits rather than sourcing restrictions, and Section 13 imposes no restraint on Corio buying comparable software or services elsewhere. The Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation terms are expressly "non-binding" and contain no commitment to source only from Commerce One; the only directional restraints (Section 2.4, barring Commerce One from contacting Corio Customers about non-ASP license sales and requiring referrals to Corio) benefit us and are not flagged. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on Customer), so no redline is required.
